product_metadata.title: iPEGTOP Super Powerful Vacuum Suction Cup Shower Soap Dish - Strong Rustproof Stainless Steel Soap Saver Sponge Holder for Bathroom & Kitchen Sink (Graphite) - 2 Pack
features: STRONG SUCTION POWER - Suction works best on NON-POROUS, SMOOTH and FLAT SURFACE, such as ceramic tile, glass, mirror, stainless steel, acrylic, etc.

ATTENTION - Suction will not work over grout lines or on porous surfaces such as: WOOD, unfinished MARBLE, GRANITE, porcelain, wallpaper, natural stones (such as Travertines), painted wall & any surface that is bumpy, etc.
NO TOOLS, NO DRILLING, NO SCREWS, NO HOLES - With the suction cup technology, it becomes extremely easy to install Soap Dish: simply position on a smooth surface, apply pressure and turn clockwise.
WORRY-FREE PURCHASE - We offer 1-Year free replacement suction cups！
